description: This file defines the Georgian (ka-GE) culture information for the DateJS library, including date and time formats, culture-specific names for days and months, regex patterns for parsing dates, and prototype extensions for date manipulations.

classes.name: Date.CultureInfo
classes.description: Object containing culture-specific information for Georgian (Georgia), such as names of days and months, date formats, regex patterns, and timezone info.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time component of a Date object to 00:00:00.000.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object’s time to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the date object to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week based on name, abbreviation, or shortest name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month based on name or abbreviation.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specific month of a year.

search-terms: Georgian regex patterns for date parsing
